title: Arthur C. Clarke's Sri Lanka mountain portal

tellings.quote: He he wrote a book about a portal in Sri Lanka on the top of a mountain.

plain: The science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke once wrote a book about a portal, a kind of doorway to somewhere else, on top of a mountain in Sri Lanka. That is how Michels tells it, in passing and without naming the book or saying what the portal was meant to do. If it were so, it would mean a famous writer had taken the idea of a real-world gateway seriously enough to write a book about it.
